title: Summit and Passage
author: A. M. Nakamura
blurb: Freya Voss, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
